note: City of Veblen town park on Wold Ave, a small camping area beside the park's shelter, playground and ball field. Camper reports describe about 8 small, unlevel sites on soft ground with power. The city has no web page or listed phone; call city hall before relying on it. --Claude
summary: No city page (cityofveblen.com is a 'Launching Soon' placeholder), no Google campground listing or phone. RV LIFE: July 2025 stay at $10/night (presence confirmed by a recent camper), 2017 review '8 sites... small, not level... Power was good'. Fees written as reported $10. Stored water/sewer hookups and FCFS are unsourced (flag). Kept per the camper-report precedent; presence question for the reviewer. Pin fine, not waterfront.
